arc.fallback: Naruto Shippūden the Movie: The Will of Fire

description.fallback: The movie ends at Mount Shumisen with Kakashi thinking about Obito, smiling at Naruto after seeing the similarities between the two. Naruto takes the smile as something creepy and random, leading the rest of the Konoha 11 to start making lewd assumptions about Kakashi. While, he hurriedly denies them, Naruto panics and flees.
